notablePrerequisites: Hope Tender and Gwenna do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding two mana of any color(s) that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and Gwenna.
Repeat.
